description: Gabarits et limitation de poids des ponts is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Gabarits et limitations de poids des ponts sur les routes départementales. Ce jeu de données détaille les gabarits des routes départementales. Les valeurs présentées correspondent aux limitations imposées par les panneaux de signalisation ou à la résistance aux charges des ouvrages. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are voirie, déplacements, transports, circulation, gabarits. The portal shows 10 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
